paragraphs.text: Mannichi (man-NEE-chee) is a kami from Kamigawa , the mischievous, strange little spirit of fevers and hallucinations.

According to The History of Kamigawa , Mannichi could be said to be partly at fault for the Kami War , as it was during a fevered dream that Takeshi Konda saw the eyes of Kyodai and understood at that moment how to make his empire last forever.
